text:
jen: FYI I opened a PR to add ZephyrX-13B + AuroraLite-7B to the catalog. Focus: supported variants, per-deployment limits, and a small migration blurb for older model names. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/854

omar: Scanning now. Two quick asks: 1) can we be explicit about which quant variants are surfaceable on Hosted vs Dedicated? 2) bench numbers look great but we should cite the suite & seed.

jen: Agree. I split the variants section into Hosted / Dedicated / Private and flagged q4/q2 variants under Dedicated only for now. Bench table includes suite name but not seed yet  will add.

cal: Benches run with long-seq:v2, seed 42. For AuroraLite the 5k/20ms numbers were single-GPU p2-small. I pushed a note about batch size used.

jen: Thanks. I updated the PR with: long-seq-suite:v2 (seed=42), batch=1 for latency.

sdk-eng: Small SDK snippet nit: new SDK uses model_id + flavor. Current PR shows a combined name ala "auroralite-7b-compact-fp16". Please switch to the recommended pattern. Example we prefer:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
cli = RedwoodClient()
resp = cli.chat_completion(
  model_id="auroralite-7b",
  flavor="compact-fp16",
  messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Explain kv-cache."}],
  max_new_tokens=150
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```Also mention fallback to a compatible flavor if requested flavor is unavailable on Hosted.

jen: Replaced the snippet and added a short migration snippet mapping old -> new names.

lucy: Quick doc copy suggestion: the "limits" section currently says "max_context: 32k" for ZephyrX. Can we change to two lines - Hosted: 32k (verified); Dedicated: 64k+ (see note) to avoid confusion?

omar: Yes, split lines please. Also add a short "How to confirm on your deployment" steps for customers.

jen: Added a 3-step confirm guide: 1) run scripts/eval/run_bench --suite long-seq-suite:v2 --model zephyrx-13b, 2) check platform logs for kv-cache allocations, 3) open a ticket with SRE for Dedicated tuning.

cal: For internal readers we also keep a sentence about kernel selection affecting max_seq, but we should strip that from the public snippet.

jen: Done. Public model card will be trimmed. Internal doc (links) remains in the internal-only section.

docs-bot: :robot_face: Link scan: missing link -> https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/long-seq-suite:v2. Marked as internal-only.

tess: I noticed the compatibility matrix is useful but kind of busy. Can we add a minimal table:
variant | hosted | dedicated | notes
q8_0    | yes    | yes       | default hosted
q4_0    | no     | yes       | quantized perf delta ~ -15%
q2_0    | no     | optional  | extremely low mem, lower perf
I'll drop that into the PR as a compact markdown table.

jen: Love it. Please add perf deltas with link to raw bench results.

omar: One more thing: add a brief "breaking changes" bullet under migration note for customers who used model name suffixes (we will map them automatically in the platform but mention that telemetry/usage labels will change).

jen: Added the breaking changes bullet and a short rollback path. Also included the CLI command example for reproducibility:```bash
# reproduce latency numbers locally
scripts/eval/run_bench --suite long-seq-suite:v2 --model zephyrx-13b --batch 1 --seed 42 --out /tmp/zephyrx.json
``` 

lucy: LGTM on copy. Tiny nit: replace "rollback path" with "rollback steps".

jen: fixed.

sdk-eng: Last SDK nit: change flavor name in snippet from "compact-fp16" to "compact.fp16" to match the catalog naming convention (dot separator).

jen: updated snippet to use "compact.fp16". Also changed max_new_tokens example to 140 per cal's perf note.

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: All links validated for public docs (internal links remain flagged). PR updated. CI: docs-lint passed, link-check flagged one internal-only URL as expected.

lucy: Approved the PR.

omar: Approved, signing off on hosted numbers. Will drop an internal follow-up for Dedicated kernel configs.

jen: Merging after a final CI run. Will backport sanitized public card in the website repo and keep the internal appendix in the internal docs area. Thanks!

docs-bot: :rocket: PR 854 merged by jen at 1795019720.
